limitations: 18-run regression screen, not a powered equivalence study.
Historical traces omit the returned posterior transformer; exact replay identity covers stored arrays and semantic final fields.
Six early noisy states and one late noisy state; the other five seed-0 runs did not reach the prescribed late checkpoint.
The single-GP-sample timing is a supplementary existing oracle, not a noisy campaign checkpoint.
Wall times between historical and candidate campaigns are not used to estimate whole-run speedup.

The original v1 manifest binds VIQR and shared acquisition/gpyreg source hashes; per-run Git/environment metadata supplies additional provenance. Future v2 manifests bind broader source, allocation, runtime and data inputs.
The final guard reuses the original campaign based on bitwise-equivalent arithmetic, exact oracle/helper checks, and exact reproduction of all captured public outputs.
Tracemalloc peaks are individual observations; timing speed claims use repeated matched calls.
